## ColumnDefinition class

A single column in a [Blueprint](./database.blueprint.md)<!-- -->, described in dialect-neutral terms.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare class ColumnDefinition 
```

## Remarks

The grammar for the active database turns these descriptions into SQL, so a migration written once runs unchanged on Postgres, MySQL and sqlite.

Every modifier returns `this`<!-- -->, so they chain. Instances come from the `Blueprint` column methods rather than being constructed directly.

## Example


```ts
table.string('email', 320).unique()
table.foreignId('team_id').constrained('teams')
```
